title: kbask.py's remediation session allows git log and git show with any trailing text, so a flag such as --output can write a file
goal: the remediation session's allowed tools hold git log and git show only in forms that take no --output (an exact command or a fixed flag list), as the cleanup session's hold kbmon.py --json exactly; kb/_self/monitoring.md says so

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbask
bad = [t for t in kbask.ALLOWED_TOOLS if t in ("Bash(git log *)", "Bash(git show *)")]
assert not bad, ("the remediation session may run git log or git show with any flag, --output=FILE included", bad)
